sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: We get messages all the time from listeners who say the show has helped them think differently about the world and about themselves.
sentences.zh: 我们经常收到听众发来的信息，他们说这个节目帮助他们以不同的方式思考世界和自身。

sentences.en: As producers, nothing is more rewarding or gratifying.
sentences.zh: 作为制作人，没有什么比这更令人欣慰或满足的了。

sentences.en: A while back, we heard a listener's story that especially moved us.
sentences.zh: 前阵子，我们听到了一位听众的故事，它深深地打动了我们。

sentences.en: Hello, Shankar and Hidden Brain team.
sentences.zh: 你好，尚卡尔和《隐藏的大脑》团队。

sentences.en: My name is Audrey Holmgren.
sentences.zh: 我叫奥黛丽·霍姆格伦。

sentences.en: The point of this message is to send you a huge thank you, as your show is the leading reason for one of the biggest decisions of my life.
sentences.zh: 发这条信息的目的是想向你们表达衷心的感谢，因为你们的节目是我人生中最重大决定背后的主要原因。

sentences.en: Today, we tell you what happened.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来讲述发生了什么。

sentences.en: It's a tale about two friends and how our show played a small role in their dramatic story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于两个朋友的故事，以及我们的节目如何在他们跌宕起伏的经历中发挥了微小的作用。

sentences.en: We begin with a young man named Alex Eastman.
sentences.zh: 我们从一个叫亚历克斯·伊斯特曼的年轻人说起。

sentences.en: Growing up in Colorado Springs, Alex was obsessed with sports and exercise.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯在科罗拉多斯普林斯长大，痴迷于运动和健身。

sentences.en: So, when I was in high school, nothing really stopped me.
sentences.zh: 所以，我在高中时，几乎没有什么能阻挡我。

sentences.en: I mean, I played sports all through high school.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我整个高中都在参加体育运动。

sentences.en: I was a year-round player.
sentences.zh: 我一年四季都在运动。

sentences.en: I did baseball, wrestling, and I played football.
sentences.zh: 我打棒球、摔跤，还踢足球。

sentences.en: But, I mean, even outside of those sports, I was consistently, you know, at the gym with all my friends during high school playing basketball or working out, going on hikes.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，即使在这些运动之外，高中时我也总是和朋友们在健身房打篮球、锻炼或去徒步旅行。

sentences.en: But something happened in the summer of 2011 when Alex was 18.
sentences.zh: 但在2011年夏天，亚历克斯18岁时，发生了一件事。

sentences.en: The biggest time that, like, finally hit me that something was wrong was when I was camping with my family out in John Martin Reservoir here in Colorado.
sentences.zh: 我真正意识到出问题了，是在我和家人在科罗拉多州的约翰·马丁水库露营的时候。

sentences.en: And it was, like, 100 degrees outside, and I started feeling ill, and my grandparents had a camper.
sentences.zh: 外面大概有100华氏度（约38摄氏度），我开始感到不舒服，我祖父母有一辆露营车。

sentences.en: So, I ended up going into the camper and passing out in their bed.
sentences.zh: 所以我最后进了露营车，在他们的床上昏睡过去。

sentences.en: Like, wrapped up in the blankets because I thought it was so cold.
sentences.zh: 我把自己裹在毯子里，因为我觉得冷得要命。

sentences.en: And I drenched the bed in sweat.
sentences.zh: 结果我把床都汗湿透了。

sentences.en: So, my parents at that point were like, yeah, no, we need to take him to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 所以当时我父母就说，不行，我们得带他去医院。

sentences.en: His parents rushed him to an emergency room in Colorado Springs, where he was diagnosed with pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 他的父母把他紧急送往科罗拉多斯普林斯的急诊室，在那里他被诊断出患有肺炎。

sentences.en: But after a few days at the hospital, it became clear that something else was wrong.
sentences.zh: 但在医院住了几天后，很明显还有别的问题。

sentences.en: And towards the last day of recovery, I went to the restroom and ended up urinating blood.
sentences.zh: 在康复的最后一天，我去洗手间，结果尿血了。

sentences.en: I didn't know what to think about it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么想。

sentences.en: And when I told the nurse, she was like, oh, yeah, let me go get the doctor, because that is not good.
sentences.zh: 当我告诉护士时，她说，哦，好的，让我去叫医生，因为这情况不好。

sentences.en: And then the doctor was like, okay, well, we need to do an ultrasound on your kidneys now.
sentences.zh: 然后医生说，好吧，我们现在需要给你的肾脏做个超声波检查。

sentences.en: The doctor came in, and then that's when he told me that I had dense deposit disease.
sentences.zh: 医生进来后，告诉我我患有致密沉积物病。

sentences.en: And he started telling us, like, how rare the disease is.
sentences.zh: 他开始告诉我们这种病有多罕见。

sentences.en: We kind of paused in silence, because none of us knew what this was.
sentences.zh: 我们沉默了片刻，因为我们谁都不知道这是什么病。

sentences.en: Dense deposit disease, also known as C3G, happens when your body's own immune system attacks the kidneys.
sentences.zh: 致密沉积物病，也称为C3G，是由于人体自身的免疫系统攻击肾脏引起的。

sentences.en: Over time, your kidneys become unable to remove waste products and extra fluid from the blood.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，你的肾脏将无法从血液中清除废物和多余的液体。

sentences.en: Eventually, it can cause total kidney failure.
sentences.zh: 最终，这会导致肾功能完全衰竭。

sentences.en: I didn't know what it meant to me or what it was going to do to me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这对意味着什么，也不知道它会对我造成什么影响。

sentences.en: But it did change my life.
sentences.zh: 但它确实改变了我的人生。

sentences.en: At first, I didn't encounter any crazy problems health-wise other than, you know, the underlying condition,
sentences.zh: 起初，除了潜在的病情外，我在健康方面没有遇到什么疯狂的问题，

sentences.en: which never really inhibited my day in any sort of way.
sentences.zh: 它从未真正以任何方式影响我的日常生活。

sentences.en: In the fall of 2013, two years after that day in the hospital, Alex was living a busy life.
sentences.zh: 2013年秋天，也就是住院那天的两年后，亚历克斯过着忙碌的生活。

sentences.en: He was in his sophomore year in college, studying human biology,
sentences.zh: 他当时大二，主修人类生物学，

sentences.en: and had just started working at a restaurant in Colorado Springs called Old Chicago.
sentences.zh: 刚开始在科罗拉多斯普林斯一家叫“老芝加哥”的餐厅工作。

sentences.en: That's where he met a young woman named Audrey Holmgren.
sentences.zh: 就在那里，他遇到了一个叫奥黛丽·霍姆格伦的年轻女子。

sentences.en: I was working downstairs serving while she was upstairs bartending.
sentences.zh: 我在楼下做服务员，而她在楼上做调酒师。

sentences.en: There was, like, nights we would close together, so we were both there till, you know, 2, 2.30, 3 o'clock in the morning,
sentences.zh: 我们有时会一起关店，所以我们俩都会待到凌晨2点、2点半或3点，

sentences.en: like, helping each other clean up what needs to be cleaned, rolling silverware, talking about the night.
sentences.zh: 互相帮忙清理需要清理的地方，卷餐具，聊聊当晚的事。

sentences.en: They became friends and started hanging out.
sentences.zh: 他们成了朋友，开始一起出去玩。

sentences.en: The long hours and grueling work brought them close.
sentences.zh: 长时间的工作和繁重的劳动让他们变得亲密。

sentences.en: It's almost like family, because you guys are sitting there getting your butts kicked the whole time,
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像家人一样，因为你们一直都在那里拼命干活，

sentences.en: but you're also helping each other with everything, and you don't ever ask questions, you just kind of do.
sentences.zh: 但你们也在各方面互相帮助，从不问为什么，只是去做而已。

sentences.en: In 2014, after working at Old Chicago for about a year, Alex's doctor told him that even though he was still healthy,
sentences.zh: 2014年，在“老芝加哥”工作了大约一年后，亚历克斯的医生告诉他，尽管他身体仍然健康，

sentences.en: it was time to go on the waiting list for a kidney transplant.
sentences.zh: 但现在是时候进入肾脏移植等待名单了。

sentences.en: For many people with dense deposit disease, complete kidney failure happens within 10 years.
sentences.zh: 对于许多患有致密沉积物病的人来说，肾功能完全衰竭会在10年内发生。

sentences.en: So Alex didn't have a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 所以亚历克斯没有多少时间了。

sentences.en: The biggest hurdle was finding a donor who would be a match.
sentences.zh: 最大的障碍是找到匹配的捐赠者。

sentences.en: Blood type is the biggest thing.
sentences.zh: 血型是最关键的因素。

sentences.en: Having someone with the same blood type helps a lot more to help you get that kidney quicker.
sentences.zh: 拥有相同血型的人能让你更快地获得肾脏。

sentences.en: At work, Alex mostly kept his condition to himself.
sentences.zh: 在工作中，亚历克斯大多对自己病情守口如瓶。

sentences.en: But later that year, he helped to organize a fundraiser for the National Kidney Foundation.
sentences.zh: 但那年晚些时候，他帮忙组织了一场为国家肾脏基金会筹款的活动。

sentences.en: Audrey was working the bar, and at the end of the night, she asked him why he cared so much about kidney disease.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽在吧台工作，那天晚上结束时，她问他为什么这么关心肾脏疾病。

sentences.en: That's when he told her what he was going through.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他告诉了她自己的遭遇。

sentences.en: You know, I'm on the transplant liSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在移植名单上。

sentences.en: I don't know when I'm going to get one.
sentences.zh: 我不知道什么时候能等到一个。

sentences.en: She was just kind of like, oh, like, you know, I'm sorry you have to do that.
sentences.zh: 她只是说，哦，你知道，我很遗憾你不得不经历这些。

sentences.en: Years passed.
sentences.zh: 几年过去了。

sentences.en: Alex's life was pretty normal, aside from taking about eight pills every day, to keep his condition under control.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯的生活相当正常，除了每天要吃大约八种药来控制病情。

sentences.en: He was still working at Old Chicago, still hanging out with Audrey and her friends,
sentences.zh: 他还在“老芝加哥”工作，依然和奥黛丽及她的朋友们混在一起，

sentences.en: still playing softball and lifting weights.
sentences.zh: 依然打垒球和举重。

sentences.en: In 2016, he graduated from college.
sentences.zh: 2016年，他大学毕业了。

sentences.en: I was a pretty active person, even with having this disease that no one even really knew that I had.
sentences.zh: 我是一个相当活跃的人，即使患有这种没人真正知道我有的疾病。

sentences.en: But by 2018, seven years after his diagnosis, his energy started to plummet.
sentences.zh: 但到了2018年，也就是确诊七年后，他的精力开始急剧下降。

sentences.en: And his relationship started to suffer.
sentences.zh: 他的感情生活也开始受到影响。

sentences.en: He remembers one day that summer, when his girlfriend wanted to plan something special for him when he got home from work.
sentences.zh: 他记得那年夏天的一天，他的女朋友想在他下班回家时为他策划一些特别的事情。

sentences.en: A date night.
sentences.zh: 一个约会之夜。

sentences.en: And she was talking to me all day about, hey, let's make dinner, or like, help me plan something.
sentences.zh: 她整天都在跟我说，嘿，我们做顿晚餐吧，或者帮我策划点什么。

sentences.en: And I was like, can we see how I feel when I get off of work?
sentences.zh: 我说，能不能等我下班看看我感觉如何再说？

sentences.en: Around seven o'clock, Alex got home.
sentences.zh: 晚上七点左右，亚历克斯到家了。

sentences.en: And I just wasn't in the mood for it.
sentences.zh: 我当时根本没心情。

sentences.en: I mean, just wanted to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我只想睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, she tried to, like, surprise me with getting everything for dinner.
sentences.zh: 她试着给我惊喜，准备了晚餐所需的一切。

sentences.en: And I just, being so tired, eating did not sound great to me at all.
sentences.zh: 但我太累了，吃东西对我来说一点吸引力都没有。

sentences.en: It did, unfortunately, become an everyday thing.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这成了常态。

sentences.en: That I just got home and most of the time I didn't want to, I didn't want to move.
sentences.zh: 我一到家，大多数时候我都不想动。

sentences.en: In December of that year, 2018, Audrey invited Alex to her 30th birthday party at a dance hall.
sentences.zh: 那年12月，2018年，奥黛丽邀请亚历克斯去参加她在舞厅举办的30岁生日派对。

sentences.en: At that point, he was on dialysis and going almost every other day.
sentences.zh: 那时，他正在接受透析，几乎每隔一天就要去一次。

sentences.en: But he didn't want to miss Audrey's birthday, so he decided to go.
sentences.zh: 但他不想错过奥黛丽的生日，所以他决定去。

sentences.en: When Alex walked into the party that night, Audrey and her husband looked at him with alarm.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上亚历克斯走进派对时，奥黛丽和她丈夫惊恐地看着他。

sentences.en: And they were like, you just don't look good.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你看上去真的很不好。

sentences.en: You don't look like yourself anymore.
sentences.zh: 你看起来不像你了。

sentences.en: I would say I was looking really tired and pale.
sentences.zh: 我会说我看起来真的很疲惫、脸色苍白。

sentences.en: Like, I lost a lot of color in my skin.
sentences.zh: 就像我的皮肤失去了很多血色。

sentences.en: Alex confessed that his condition was getting worse.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯承认他的病情正在恶化。

sentences.en: He wasn't feeling well.
sentences.zh: 他感觉很不舒服。

sentences.en: And pretty soon, he'd be spending even more time in dialysis.
sentences.zh: 很快，他将不得不花更多时间进行透析。

sentences.en: He had to find a kidney donor.
sentences.zh: 他必须找到一个肾脏捐赠者。

sentences.en: And according to his doctor, he had to find one soon.
sentences.zh: 根据医生的说法，他必须尽快找到一个。

sentences.en: Audrey asked herself whether she would be willing to donate a kidney to Alex.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽问自己是否愿意给亚历克斯捐献一个肾脏。

sentences.en: But she knew his blood type was O positive.
sentences.zh: 但她知道他的血型是O型阳性。

sentences.en: And hers was AB.
sentences.zh: 而她是AB型。

sentences.en: She wasn't a match.
sentences.zh: 她不匹配。

sentences.en: Some kidney donations can take place between donors of different blood types.
sentences.zh: 有些肾脏捐赠可以在不同血型的捐赠者之间进行。

sentences.en: But patients with type O blood typically need donors who are also type O.
sentences.zh: 但O型血的患者通常需要同样是O型的捐赠者。

sentences.en: A donation between them would never work.
sentences.zh: 他们之间的捐赠是不可能的。

sentences.en: As the months passed, Alex's health continued to decline.
sentences.zh: 随着几个月过去，亚历克斯的健康状况持续恶化。

sentences.en: It was a tough time.
sentences.zh: 那是一段艰难的时光。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: From what I remember, it was a very, you know, I didn't leave the house.
sentences.zh: 据我记得，那是非常，你知道，我几乎不出门。

sentences.en: I mean, you don't realize, I guess, what I'm saying is you don't realize how much the kidney does for you until yours doesn't work anymore.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你没有意识到，我想说的是，你没有意识到肾脏为你做了多少，直到你的肾脏不再工作。

sentences.en: Alex was at a low point.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯处于低谷期。

sentences.en: But his luck was about to change.
sentences.zh: 但他的运气即将改变。

sentences.en: One morning in March of 2019, Alex was in dialysis when his phone started to buzz.
sentences.zh: 2019年3月的一个早晨，亚历克斯正在透析时，手机开始震动。

sentences.en: It was Audrey.
sentences.zh: 是奥黛丽打来的。

sentences.en: It was Audrey.
sentences.zh: 是奥黛丽。

sentences.en: After the break, Audrey's story.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，奥黛丽的故事。

sentences.en: I said, bingo, that's it.
sentences.zh: 我说，宾果，就是这个。

sentences.en: That's what we need to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们需要做的。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam, and you're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆，你正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Before the break, we met a young man named Alex Eastman.
sentences.zh: 休息之前，我们认识了一位叫亚历克斯·伊斯特曼的年轻人。

sentences.en: He told us about his struggle with dense deposit disease, which was slowly destroying his kidneys and eroding his quality of life.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们他与致密沉积物病的斗争，这种病正在缓慢地摧毁他的肾脏，侵蚀他的生活质量。

sentences.en: When we left off, Alex had already spent almost five years on the transplant list, waiting for someone with the same blood type to donate a kidney to him.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才说到，亚历克斯已经在移植名单上待了近五年，等待着血型相同的人为他捐献肾脏。

sentences.en: He was on dialysis three days a week, and at the age of 26, it seemed like his life was ending.
sentences.zh: 他每周接受三次透析，在26岁时，他的生命似乎走到了尽头。

sentences.en: His doctor told him he didn't have much time.
sentences.zh: 医生告诉他，他没有多少时间了。

sentences.en: His friend Audrey briefly asked herself if she wanted to donate a kidney to him, but her blood type wasn't a match.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友奥黛丽曾短暂地问过自己是否愿意给他捐肾，但她的血型不匹配。

sentences.en: She was type AB.
sentences.zh: 她是AB型。

sentences.en: He was type O.
sentences.zh: 他是O型。

sentences.en: And then, in March of 2019, Audrey heard an episode of Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2019年3月，奥黛丽听了一期《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I was listening to the Hidden Brain episode for Sale by Owner, and Al Roth was speaking about the paired exchange program.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在听《隐藏的大脑》关于“业主自售”的那一期，阿尔·罗斯正在谈论配对交换计划。

sentences.en: The paired exchange program is a novel way to donate kidneys, thought up by the economist Al Roth and his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 配对交换计划是一种新颖的肾脏捐赠方式，由经济学家阿尔·罗斯和他的同事们构思。

sentences.en: In traditional kidney exchange, donors have to be carefully matched to recipients with compatible blood types and other factors.
sentences.zh: 在传统的肾脏交换中，捐赠者必须与血型兼容及其他因素的接受者仔细匹配。

sentences.en: But by applying the insights of game theory, Al Roth realized that a donor did not need to have a compatible blood type with their intended recipient.
sentences.zh: 但通过应用博弈论的见解，阿尔·罗斯意识到捐赠者不需要与他们的预期接受者血型兼容。

sentences.en: I could donate an organ to your loved one, and you could donate an organ to mine.
sentences.zh: 我可以给你的亲人捐献一个器官，而你可以给我的亲人捐献一个器官。

sentences.en: As soon as Audrey heard about this idea in our episode, she sent a text to Alex.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽在我们的节目中听到这个想法后，立刻给亚历克斯发了条短信。

sentences.en: And I said, hey, do you know what kidney exchange is?
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，你知道什么是肾脏交换吗？

sentences.en: And he texted back, and he said, yes, I know what this is,
sentences.zh: 他回信说，是的，我知道这是什么，

sentences.en: but nobody is really willing to do it for me because they don't like the idea that their kidney is not going directly to me.
sentences.zh: 但没人愿意为我做，因为他们不喜欢他们的肾脏不能直接给我的想法。

sentences.en: And I messaged him back, and I said, well, that's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 我回信说，好吧，那太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Why haven't you told me about this?
sentences.zh: 你为什么没告诉我这个？

sentences.en: Where do I go to sign up to see about doing this?
sentences.zh: 我去哪里报名看看能不能做这个？

sentences.en: So he sent me the link.
sentences.zh: 于是他把链接发给了我。

sentences.en: So I looked it up, and I immediately started doing the application.
sentences.zh: 我查了一下，立刻开始填写申请表。

sentences.en: And halfway down the application, it definitely asks for your blood type.
sentences.zh: 申请表填到一半时，它确实询问了你的血型。

sentences.en: And I could not remember if it was AB positive or AB negative.
sentences.zh: 我记不清是AB型阳性还是AB型阴性了。

sentences.en: Audrey went upstairs to her office, where her husband, Zeb, was playing video games.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽走到楼上的办公室，她的丈夫泽布正在玩电子游戏。

sentences.en: She walked over to the filing cabinet where they kept their medical records and pulled out the folder with her blood type in it.
sentences.zh: 她走到存放医疗记录的文件柜前，拿出了装有她血型的文件夹。

sentences.en: A little piece of paper, the size of a credit card, fell to the floor.
sentences.zh: 一张信用卡大小的小纸片掉到了地板上。

sentences.en: And we pick up the card because it fell face down.
sentences.zh: 我们捡起那张卡片，因为它掉下来时是正面朝下的。

sentences.en: And we flipped it over, and it said, O positive.
sentences.zh: 我们把它翻过来，上面写着：O型阳性。

sentences.en: O positive, just like Alex.
sentences.zh: O型阳性，和亚历克斯的一样。

sentences.en: A few months earlier, when she had considered donating an organ to her friend, Audrey had misremembered her blood type.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，当奥黛丽考虑给她的朋友捐赠器官时，她记错了自己的血型。

sentences.en: She was, in fact, a perfect match.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她完全匹配。

sentences.en: Alex would not have to wait for the paired exchange program to get a viable organ.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯不必再等待配对交换计划来获得可用的器官了。

sentences.en: She could directly give him her kidney.
sentences.zh: 她可以直接把肾脏捐给他。

sentences.en: We could hear the angels, like, going, oh.
sentences.zh: 我们仿佛能听到天使在说，噢。

sentences.en: So I started crying, because that's just who I am.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始哭，因为我就是这样的人。

sentences.en: I am an emotional human.
sentences.zh: 我是一个感性的人。

sentences.en: So, and I immediately text Alex, and I say, Alex, I know I had just texted you about doing the paired exchange,
sentences.zh: 所以，我立刻给亚历克斯发了短信，我说，亚历克斯，我知道我刚给你发过关于参加配对交换计划的事，

sentences.en: but I am a match.
sentences.zh: 但我匹配上了。

sentences.en: And so we both, we both were texting expletives through each other, no way, you're kidding, you're joking, what is happening?
sentences.zh: 于是我们俩都在短信里爆了粗口，不敢相信，你在开玩笑吧，你在逗我，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And so I exit out of that application on my computer, and I open up the application to be a donor.
sentences.zh: 然后我退出了电脑上的那个申请程序，打开了捐赠者的申请页面。

sentences.en: And within a month, we got a surgery scheduled.
sentences.zh: 不到一个月，我们就安排好了手术。

sentences.en: I remember it was really early, and the sun was just coming up.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时很早，太阳刚刚升起。

sentences.en: And I remember we were walking into the hospital, and the sunrise was just so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们走进医院时，日出美极了。

sentences.en: I remember that the morning itself was very quiet.
sentences.zh: 我记得那天早晨非常安静。

sentences.en: So walking into the hospital, there's not a lot of people there yet.
sentences.zh: 走进医院时，那里还没多少人。

sentences.en: The hustle and bustle hasn't started.
sentences.zh: 喧嚣还没开始。

sentences.en: There was a lot of peace in that moment, waiting to be called back.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，在等待被叫进去的时候，内心感到非常平静。

sentences.en: I believe Audrey got called back first, and she went back, and then I was shortly right after her.
sentences.zh: 我想奥黛丽先被叫进去了，她进去了，我紧随其后。

sentences.en: And they ended up actually seating us right next to each other in, like, the pre-surgery waiting room.
sentences.zh: 他们最后竟然把我们安排在手术前的候诊室里相邻的座位上。

sentences.en: And as they were putting in the IV, and they're setting me up, checking my vitals, all that,
sentences.zh: 当他们给我扎静脉注射，帮我做准备，检查生命体征时，

sentences.en: that's when the emotions really started, because it became real in that moment.
sentences.zh: 那一刻情绪真的涌上来了，因为一切变得真实了。

sentences.en: When the needle of the IV went into my arm, I was like, oh, okay, we're doing this.
sentences.zh: 当静脉注射的针头扎进我的手臂时，我心想，噢，好吧，我们要开始了。

sentences.en: This is what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们要做的。

sentences.en: We're actually, I'm donating a kidney today.
sentences.zh: 我们真的，我今天就要捐出一个肾脏了。

sentences.en: And then I just remember Audrey going back, and then my mom's over there hugging her.
sentences.zh: 然后我记得奥黛丽进去了，我妈妈在那边拥抱她。

sentences.en: And that is when I just broke down.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: I was like, ah!
sentences.zh: 我心想，啊！

sentences.en: And I just start weeping.
sentences.zh: 我开始痛哭流涕。

sentences.en: I was like, oh my God, I'm doing this.
sentences.zh: 我心想，天哪，我真的要这么做了。

sentences.en: And we're just crying in each other's arms before the surgery.
sentences.zh: 手术前，我们只是在彼此怀里哭泣。

sentences.en: And she just simply says thank you.
sentences.zh: 她只是简单地说了一句谢谢。

sentences.en: Everyone's just getting really emotional about what's going on.
sentences.zh: 每个人都对正在发生的事情感到非常激动。

sentences.en: And then shortly after her, I was right up behind her going to my surgery room.
sentences.zh: 在她之后不久，我就紧随其后进了手术室。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, this is the day.
sentences.zh: 我心想，噢，就是今天了。

sentences.en: And finally, you know, live my life back to pretty much how it was before all this.
sentences.zh: 终于，你知道，我的生活又回到了这一切发生之前的样子。

sentences.en: And I remember waking up and like kind of seeing all my family there.
sentences.zh: 我记得醒来时看到我的家人们都在那里。

sentences.en: Alex knew something was different right away, because for the first time in about five years,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯立刻察觉到了不同，因为大约五年来第一次，

sentences.en: he didn't feel cold anymore.
sentences.zh: 他不再感到寒冷了。

sentences.en: Instantly, that's when I felt it.
sentences.zh: 那一瞬间，我立刻感觉到了。

sentences.en: And even like my parents kind of noticed it.
sentences.zh: 甚至连我父母也注意到了。

sentences.en: They were like, wow, you're actually like hot right now.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哇，你现在真的感觉很暖和。

sentences.en: And I was like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我说，是啊。

sentences.en: And then from there, they said that my color was already coming back.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们说我的气色已经恢复了。

sentences.en: And that I just overall looked better than what I was looking six hours ago before surgery.
sentences.zh: 而且总的来说，我看起来比手术前六个小时好多了。

sentences.en: It wasn't until I got out of the hospital that I really started to notice it,
sentences.zh: 直到出院后，我才真正开始注意到这一点，

sentences.en: because my energy was just above and beyond what it used to be.
sentences.zh: 因为我的精力远超从前。

sentences.en: I overall just feel normal, like everything that wasn't there post-surgery is right back to where it used to be.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己完全恢复了正常，手术后缺失的一切都回到了原来的位置。

sentences.en: It's kind of turned us from friends to family.
sentences.zh: 这让我们从朋友变成了家人。

sentences.en: He and his family have just wrapped their arms around us.
sentences.zh: 他和他的家人一直张开双臂拥抱我们。

sentences.en: We are one of their kids at this point.
sentences.zh: 现在我们就像他们的孩子一样。

sentences.en: I consider Alex part of my family.
sentences.zh: 我把亚历克斯视为我的家人。

sentences.en: Yeah, like we were good friends before, but our friendship grew a thousand times.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们以前就是好朋友，但我们的友谊增长了千倍。

sentences.en: I could just never be thankful enough.
sentences.zh: 我永远感激不尽。

sentences.en: There are lots of reasons we love to make Hidden Brain for you.
sentences.zh: 我们热爱为您制作《Hidden Brain》节目有很多原因。

sentences.en: Stories like this one are close to the top of the liSt.
sentences.zh: 像这样的故事在我们的榜单上名列前茅。

sentences.en: We're grateful you've allowed us to play a small role in your life.
sentences.zh: 感谢您让我们在您的生活中扮演了一个小小的角色。

sentences.en: Hidden Brain is produced by Hidden Brain Media.
sentences.zh: 《Hidden Brain》由 Hidden Brain Media 制作。

sentences.en: Our audio production team includes Bridget McCarthy, Laura Querell, Ryan Katz, Kristen Wong, Autumn Barnes, and Andrew Chadwick.
sentences.zh: 我们的音频制作团队包括 Bridget McCarthy、Laura Querell、Ryan Katz、Kristen Wong、Autumn Barnes 和 Andrew Chadwick。

sentences.en: Tara Boyle is our executive producer.
sentences.zh: Tara Boyle 是我们的执行制片人。

sentences.en: I'm Hidden Brain's executive editor.
sentences.zh: 我是《Hidden Brain》的执行编辑。

sentences.en: If this episode spoke to you, if our show is meaningful to you, please consider supporting us.
sentences.zh: 如果这一集触动了您，如果我们的节目对您有意义，请考虑支持我们。

sentences.en: Go to hiddenbrain.org and click on support.
sentences.zh: 请访问 hiddenbrain.org 并点击“支持”。

sentences.en: Again, that's hiddenbrain.org and click on support.
sentences.zh: 再说一遍，访问 hiddenbrain.org 并点击“支持”。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是 Shankar Vedantam。

sentences.en: See you soon.
sentences.zh: 再见。
